fullMarkdown:
# CHAPTER 1. A WOUND IN THE WORLD.

<!-- scene-id: 6cd862f7-56ee-4aa7-8d86-6a5a33eb4727 -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS - DAY

An EXTREME WIDE SHOT reveals the desert of Serephis. It is not a sea of gold, but the scorched corpse of a kingdom. Under a sickly bruise-colored overcast sky, the landscape is a jagged expanse of shattered black glass and grey ash, stretching toward a horizon that wavers in the rising heat.

A solitary speck of gold moves across the obsidian waste.

<!-- scene-id: 73058eb8-138a-43b3-907b-d60ba683dac2 -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS - BLACK GLASS FLATS - DAY

MIGUEL, the archangel General of the Celestial Host, marches through the ruin. He is a towering adult male with a lean, powerful athletic build, wearing heavy golden celestial plate armor, intricately etched but battered, dusty, and visibly cracked from the old Onyx Gates campaign.

Two enormous pearl-white feathered wings rise from his back, their pristine feathers lightly stained with fine grey ash and showing subtle old burn wear.

The ground beneath his sabatons is a sheet of fused black glass. With every step, the surface splinters with a dry rhythmic sound. He carries the weight of twelve days of travel.

<!-- scene-id: 24d9f456-e41d-46a6-ae6e-f1fad3748b06 -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS - ASH DUNES - LATER

A CLOSE TRACKING SHOT follows Miguel. His ash-white hair moves slightly in the dry wind. His electric-cyan eyes remain faintly luminous, with the light contained entirely inside the eyes.

The golden armor is failing. Deep cracks spiderweb across the breastplate. The metal groans with every stride.

Miguel falters. His breathing is shallow through grit-coated lungs.

His gauntleted hand rises instinctively to the center of his sternum. He presses against the source of a phantom cold, searching for a wound that is not physically there: the hollow.

He stares at the horizon like a man haunted by a question he cannot yet name.

<!-- scene-id: 084f2eb0-f48f-4535-8240-61a36a855387 -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS - THE BURIED ROAD - CONTINUOUS

Miguel trudges up the face of a steep ash dune. His boot sinks into the grey powder, then strikes something solid.

He freezes. The sound is not breaking glass, but the dull thud of stone.

Miguel drops to one knee and brushes away the ash with his fingers. Beneath the soot lies a worked paving block with perfectly square edges. He clears more space and reveals a second block, then a third.

A wide ancient road emerges from the waste. It runs in a straight, defiant line toward the same horizon Miguel has been following.

He looks down at the worked stone, then back toward the hollow in his chest.

For the first time in twelve days, his hand stops trembling.

##### FADE TO BLACK:

<!-- scene-id: gabriel-arrival -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS DESERT - DAY

The stillness breaks on a clean chord of harmony. GABRIEL arrives, robe of blue and silver, wings folding against the desert gloom, soft light pushing back the shadows around him.

MIGUEL feels relief sharp enough to hurt, and close behind it, shame at being seen unraveled like this.

GABRIEL
The Council is concerned, Miguel.

GABRIEL
They fear this is a deception, a lure the enemy crafted to draw you out. Your absence puts fear in the Host.

MIGUEL
They think me a fool. Or a traitor.

Gabriel shifts his weight. A parchment sealed in black wax shows briefly against his ribs, then vanishes again as he settles. He does not name it.

GABRIEL
They think you are their general.

The shift from envoy to brother strikes deeper than any order could. For one breath, Miguel forgets everything else.

<!-- scene-id: onyx-gates-flashback -->
### INT. ONYX GATES - FLASHBACK

The Burning Fortress collapses into an abyss of sulfur smoke and infernal fire. Black columns crack and sink into the dark. MIGUEL lies fallen among the rubble, one wing broken and smoldering.

GABRIEL runs in through the flames — sent by no one — and kneels at his side, cauterizing the wing with his own light.

GABRIEL
Because you don't yell for help in the voice you use for people you love. You go yourself.

The wing heals under his light, the charred feathers settling.

<!-- scene-id: gabriel-departure -->
### EXT. SEREPHIS DESERT - DAY

Gabriel's hand, back in Serephis's cold light, rises, hesitates, and falls back to his side, the gesture unfinished.

GABRIEL
Come home. Whatever this wound is, we face it together. As we always have.

Miguel wavers, then looks down at the buried road's stones beneath his feet, and up, meeting his brother's eyes for the first time since he arrived.

MIGUEL
I cannot. This call is a command more fundamental than any the Council can give me. It is a truth I must find, or I am nothing.

Gabriel does not argue. His light dims a fraction. A single tear of light traces his cheek.

GABRIEL
May you find what you seek, brother.

He folds away into the space between worlds, the sealed parchment still unmentioned against his ribs. Miguel stands looking at the empty space. The heat and silence of Serephis return, heavier than before.

##### FADE TO:

<!-- scene-id: the-threshold -->
### EXT. THE THRESHOLD - CONTINUOUS

One step on burning sand; the next, on cool moss. The oppressive heat gives way to a still coolness that tastes of metal. MIGUEL has reached the Grove — trees of pale metal rising in perfect ranks, casting an even light that throws no shadow at all.

His tactical mind reads the ground at once: ambush. He tries to recite a verse of the Divine Song to center himself, and cannot recall the words. Every leaf that cracks beneath his boots sounds like a shout in a library. He feels measured, by something he cannot see.

<!-- scene-id: the-pewter-grove -->
### EXT. THE PEWTER GROVE - CONTINUOUS

One of the metal trees, forty paces off, no longer matches the angle of the others. Miguel turns and finds the PEWTER SENTINEL — tall as the trees themselves, its face a smooth surface without a single feature, two dim eyes glowing from within the mist.

MIGUEL
I have come for what is mine.

The Sentinel offers no answer. Its stillness feels like a reply anyway. Miguel advances toward the grove's center, testing the silence for a line he is not meant to cross. The line never comes. The Sentinel turns, smooth and soundless, to keep facing him as he passes — like a compass needle holding north. Its gaze rests on his back long after the trees hide it from view.

<!-- scene-id: the-ash-tree-clearing -->
### EXT. THE ASH TREE CLEARING - CONTINUOUS

At the grove's center stands the great ash, its bark the color of cooled lava, roots drinking from a pool of static silver light. Driven into the trunk: SOLMIRE, not forged metal but living, solidified light.

The instant Miguel sees it, the hollow in his chest goes silent. This is not the thought *that is a sword*. It is absolute, terrifying recognition: *that is what was taken from me.*

He stops before the ash, hand trembling as he raises it. His fingers hover inches from the hilt, caught between hunger and dread.

The moment skin meets hilt, the grove vanishes.

##### FADE TO WHITE:

assets.name: Serephis — Dead Desert
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A dead, ruined desert that feels like the scorched corpse of a lost kingdom. The ground is a fractured crust of shattered black glass sheets and grey ash, broken into sharp plates and splinters, with endless dunes of pale ash stretching toward the horizon. Heat haze rises directly from the earth rather than from the sky. The sky is a sick bruise-colored overcast, heavy with muted violet-grey clouds. No vegetation, no water, no ruins rising above the dunes, no visible life, no other figures. The landscape must feel vast, hostile, ancient, and crushingly solitary. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, refined materials, desaturated palette, sacred desolation, clean readable composition.

assets.name: The Buried Road
assets.physicalCharacteristics: An ancient ceremonial road emerging in fragments from the ash dunes of Serephis. The road is built from large worked paving stones with perfectly square edges, worn smooth down the center by countless feet over centuries. It is unusually wide, broad enough for ten people to walk abreast. Only short sections are uncovered while most of it disappears beneath grey ash dunes on both sides, suggesting a buried forgotten kingdom beneath the desert. No modern materials, no asphalt, no road markings, no vegetation. The scene should feel archaeological, solemn, and quietly monumental, like the memory of civilization resurfacing through ruin. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, refined ancient stone textures, muted atmosphere, clean composition.

assets.name: The Grove
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A deeply uncanny artificial grove formed by identical trees planted in a perfect grid. Every tree is cast entirely from solid pewter-like metal with a matte machined surface: trunks, branches, and every leaf are metallic, pale grey, and unnaturally precise. The leaves are thin flat metal blades, not natural foliage. The ground is covered in cool muted green moss, soft underfoot, creating an unsettling contrast with the rigid metallic trees. No bark, no wood grain, no living greenery in the canopy, no dead trees, no animals, no wind movement. The grove should feel silent, symmetrical, glacial, and watchful, like an abandoned sacred library built by something inhuman. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, refined metallic materials, flat eerie stillness, controlled composition.

assets.name: The Ash Tree Clearing
assets.physicalCharacteristics:
At the exact center of the Grove lies a circular clearing surrounding one immense ash tree, far larger and more ancient than the identical metallic trees around it. Its bark is rough, black, and cracked like cooled volcanic lava. Massive roots descend into a circular pool of static silver light with no visible source, as if the ground itself remembers an ancient power. Driven into the trunk is a sword made of living white-glacial light, the only true light source in the clearing. Its cold radiance reflects in the silver pool and softly illuminates the dark bark and nearby roots. Pale metallic leaves from the surrounding grove frame the scene at the edges. The clearing must feel sacred, forbidden, ancient, and world-defining, as if reality itself has gone still around this place. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, controlled cold lighting, black volcanic textures, silver reflections, solemn mythic atmosphere.
The silver light around the roots is a shallow circular pool of static luminous substance, not a magical ring, portal, rune circle, or energy barrier. Its edges are naturally irregular where the roots enter the pool.
assets.timeOfDay: Cold Gloom, lit only by the sword and pool

assets.name: The Burning Fortress (Flashback)
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A catastrophic memory of a black-stone fortress collapsing into an abyss of sulfur smoke and infernal fire. Towering black columns crack, tilt, and sink into darkness while burning stone underfoot splits open with glowing fissures. The architecture feels ancient, monumental, and war-shattered. Firelight and smoke create violent expressionist chiaroscuro, with extreme contrast, deep shadows, and a sense of sacred ruin being swallowed by the abyss. Embers drift through the air, and the entire scene should feel unstable, traumatic, and apocalyptic. This is not the present but a memory of war and loss. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, refined black stone and molten textures, dramatic catastrophic lighting, abyssal scale.

assets.name: Pewter Sentinel
assets.physicalCharacteristics:
An ethereal sentinel of the Grove, appearing as a tall, elegant humanoid wisp formed from pale silver mist, pewter-toned vapor, and drifting translucent currents. Its body is only loosely defined, with a slender elongated silhouette, narrow shoulders, long tapering arms, and a lower body that dissolves gradually into smoke and suspended vapor instead of clearly separated legs or feet. The figure hovers slightly above the ground.

Its face is smooth, ambiguous, and nearly featureless — not fully human — with only the faint suggestion of cheekbones, nose, and mouth beneath a veil of mist. Two dim cold-white eyes glow softly from within the haze, without strong facial expression. No hair, no visible eyebrows, no clear mouth detail. It should feel ancient, watchful, silent, and emotionally unreadable.

Its surface and energy subtly echo the Grove itself: traces of pewter sheen, faint green reflections from moss below, and delicate leaf-like metallic fragments drifting within its vapor. Small ornamental pewter-like shards and ribbon-thin metallic wisps seem naturally fused into its upper body and shoulders, as if grown from the same supernatural material rather than worn as clothing. The whole figure should feel graceful, eerie, sacred, and unnatural — more like a lingering guardian-spirit than a living being.
Avoid a realistic human anatomy or mannequin-like appearance; the form should remain semi-abstract, spectral, and lightly unfinished, as if constantly forming and dissolving.
assets.clothingAccessories: No conventional clothing. No fabric garments, no armor, and no weapons. Only subtle integrated pewter-like ornamental fragments and fine metallic ribbon-like wisps naturally emerging from the spirit’s upper body and shoulders.

assets.name: Solmire (Libro I — versión blanca/glacial)
assets.physicalCharacteristics:
Preserve Solmire as a white/glacial sword made entirely from living solidified light.

Remove the conventional crossguard and traditional sword hilt.

The blade, grip and transition between them should read as one seamless continuous form of condensed white-glacial light, with no separate metal components, no wrapping, no jewels and no ornament.

Keep a straight elegant double-edged blade profile with faint icy-blue edges.

The grip may be subtly shaped for a hand, but it must remain part of the same uninterrupted luminous material as the blade.

Its light is steady, cold and pure, like frozen moonlight given physical form.

No sparks, no flames, no particles, no pulsing light.

Do not turn it into a conventional metal sword.

assets.name: Council Order
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A formal ancient celestial parchment rolled or folded compactly, made from pale ivory material with subtle age and texture. Sealed with dense black wax bearing an austere official council sigil. No bright gold decoration, no modern paper, no ribbon bow. Serious, ceremonial and authoritative.

assets.name: Miguel
assets.physicalCharacteristics: MIGUEL, archangel General of the Celestial Host. Adult male, apparent age 35–40, towering 2.25m, lean powerful athletic build with broad shoulders and a commanding heroic presence. Severe, handsome face with high sharp cheekbones, a strong square jaw, straight nose, and a calm but intimidating expression. Short ash-white hair, thick and windswept, with soft texture and volume. Brilliant electric-cyan glowing eyes, intense and focused; the glow must remain contained inside the irises and pupils only, never spilling onto the skin. Fair healthy skin with a luminous, noble quality, not corpse-pale. Two enormous pearl-white feathered wings, symmetrical and pristine, with soft pale-blue iridescence, faint silver-blue highlights, and subtle celestial energy filaments running delicately between some feathers. The wings should feel majestic, sacred, and controlled rather than wild or storm-like. High-end cinematic stylized 3D fantasy character design, realistic adult proportions, refined materials, and polished heroic presence.
assets.clothingAccessories: Ornate celestial armor in polished gold, elegant and noble rather than bulky. Large sculpted pauldrons with feather motifs, engraved decorative filigree, and a radiant eight-point star emblem set at the center of the chest, glowing cyan-white as the main focal point. The breastplate is symmetrical and regal, with wing-inspired embossed ornamentation. Under the armor, deep midnight-blue fabric is visible at the neck, inner arms, and tabard. The lower half includes matching gold faulds, greaves, and armored boots, with a long dark-blue tabard panel trimmed in gold hanging from the waist. Hands are protected by dark fitted gloves. No leather chest strap, no asymmetrical harness crossing the torso. The overall outfit must read as a unified divine war-regalia set: radiant, disciplined, ceremonial, and unmistakably archangelic.

assets.name: Gabriel
assets.physicalCharacteristics: GABRIEL, Archangel of the Divine Voice. Adult male, apparent age early thirties, standing 1.95m tall, with clearly masculine proportions: broad shoulders, a strong neck, a lean yet solid build, and long, well-balanced limbs. Handsome but distinctly male, never feminine or androgynous. He has a refined, noble face with a strong jawline, defined chin, straight nose, subtle masculine brow structure, and calm, symmetrical features. His long, straight black hair is parted at the center, smooth and well-kept, falling past the shoulders. His eyes are clear sapphire-blue, luminous in color but not emitting any outward glow. His skin is fair, healthy, subtly radiant, and naturally alive. He has two large white feathered wings with faint pale-blue iridescence and a soft celestial sheen, elegant, pristine, and perfectly symmetrical. His overall presence feels calm, wise, fraternal, and authoritative. He should read instantly as a majestic male archangel: graceful, serene, and noble, yet unmistakably masculine. High-end cinematic stylized 3D fantasy character design, realistic adult anatomy, refined materials, and controlled soft lighting.
assets.clothingAccessories:
Flowing royal-blue and silver ceremonial robes, elegant and sacred, with no heavy armor. The layered robes should create a structured masculine silhouette: broad shoulder line, fitted upper torso, long vertical drape, and clean noble lines. Silver embroidered feather motifs and sacred ornamental patterns are integrated into the robe borders, chest panel, sleeves, and collar. A refined high collar frames the neck. Wide sleeves and layered lower robes add dignity and movement without making the figure appear delicate or feminine. Subtle ceremonial silver bracers or forearm guards may be included. A tall, slender silver staff that is elegant, sacred, and dignified, serving both as a symbol of office and a divine instrument. The clothing should communicate celestial nobility, sacred eloquence, wisdom, and calm authority.
Gabriel does not inherently carry any weapon or staff. Vox Aeternum is a separate prop and must only appear when explicitly assigned to the scene. Preserve Gabriel's exact facial identity, hairstyle, robe design, colors, body proportions, and wings consistently across all scenes.

assets.name: Lucifer
assets.physicalCharacteristics:
LUCIFER, fallen archangel and infernal sovereign. Adult male, apparent age early thirties, around 2.10m tall, with a powerful, elegant, battle-capable build — broad shoulders, long limbs, strong posture, and the controlled physical presence of someone fully capable of standing against Miguel in direct combat. He must not feel fragile, delicate, or vampiric.

His face is strikingly beautiful but severe and intimidating rather than romantic: high cheekbones, straight nose, strong refined jawline, slightly sharper brow, and a calm but merciless expression. His skin is very pale, but not corpse-like — more like cold ivory or moonlit marble, still living and luminous rather than dead. Long silver-white hair falls past his shoulders in soft controlled waves. His eyes are deep wine-red, intense and unnerving, with a subtle inner glow contained inside the irises only.

He should radiate supreme confidence, menace, and infernal authority. His presence must feel ancient, oppressive, and sovereign — the presence of a fallen celestial warlord, not a gothic vampire. He is terrifying because he is calm, powerful, and perfectly in control. Two enormous black feathered wings rise behind him, vast and imposing, elegant yet predatory, so dark they seem to absorb nearby light. The wings should feel powerful and heavy, like they belong to a being made for both dominion and war.

Overall impression: a fallen archangel king and infernal equal to Miguel — beautiful, cold, commanding, and unmistakably dangerous. High-end cinematic stylized 3D dark-fantasy animation, realistic adult male proportions, refined materials, dramatic but controlled lighting.
He should look like a being who could command hell and still cross blades with the greatest of heaven without hesitation.
His physique should be lean and sculpted but undeniably strong, with the presence of a celestial warrior rather than a frail noble.
assets.clothingAccessories:
Layered black ceremonial battle-robes with a regal and militaristic silhouette. The design should feel noble, ancient, and severe, with structured shoulders, a strong vertical line, and subtle architectural shaping that gives him the presence of a dark celestial commander rather than a simple robed figure. Predominantly matte black, charcoal, and near-black obsidian tones, with extremely subtle dark metallic detailing integrated into the collar, inner seams, cuffs, and chest structure.

The outfit should suggest restrained infernal nobility and fallen divine rank. No bright ornamentation, no gold heroic motifs, and no decorative excess. Very subtle dark red undertones may appear in deep inner folds or lining, hinting at infernal corruption without overpowering the black design. The clothing may include understated fitted underlayers or structured panels that imply combat readiness and physical power beneath the robes.

No horns, no tail, no monstrous demon traits, no gothic vampire styling, and no fragile aristocratic softness. The final silhouette must read as a fallen archangel sovereign and war-capable rival to Miguel: elegant, intimidating, and battle-worthy.

assets.name: Vox Aeternum
assets.physicalCharacteristics: A tall ceremonial divine staff used by Gabriel, elegant and refined rather than brutal. Crafted from luminous silver-white metal with subtle blue undertones, perfectly smooth and noble in shape. Long, straight shaft, balanced proportions, sacred and dignified silhouette. The head of the staff should feel like an instrument of divine resonance and sacred speech, not a warrior’s mace or a wizard’s crooked staff. It may include a restrained celestial motif or resonance-shaped crown, but must remain elegant, clean and high-ranking. Emits a soft controlled glow in silver-blue tones, never chaotic. No excessive gems, no barbaric details, no demonic shapes. This is a sacred archangelic artifact associated with divine voice, command, seals, hymns and resonance.

frames.title: The Scorched Kingdom
frames.visualDescription: An extreme wide shot of the desert of Serephis under a bruise-colored, overcast sky. The landscape is a jagged expanse of shattered black glass and grey ash, reaching toward a distorted, shimmering horizon. No character is visible yet — the scale of the wasteland is immense, dwarfing any sense of life or hope.
frames.audioDescription: A low, mournful wind whistles through the jagged glass shards. The air hums with a faint, oppressive heat distortion sound.
frames.motionDescription: The camera slowly pans across the horizon, emphasizing the vast and desolate scale of the environment.

frames.title: The Golden Speck
frames.visualDescription: From a high angle, MIGUEL — the golden-armored archangel — is visible as a small speck moving slowly across the obsidian waste of the Black Glass Flats. The bright gold of his armor contrasts sharply with the dark, monochromatic landscape surrounding him. He appears tiny and vulnerable against the backdrop of the dead kingdom.
frames.audioDescription: The sound of metal crunching softly against glass and ash begins to rise above the wind. Each footstep echoes with a lonely, rhythmic cadence.
frames.motionDescription: A slow zoom-in begins, gradually bringing the distant golden figure into clearer focus.

frames.title: Journey Through Ash
frames.visualDescription: The camera captures MIGUEL, the golden-armored archangel, from a mid-distance as he navigates through the Ash Dunes. Heat waves waver in the foreground, blurring the edges of the shattered glass. The oppressive sky hangs low over his path as he trudges forward.
frames.audioDescription: The crunch of Sabatons on the grey ash becomes the primary sound, mixed with the rustle of the wind shifting fine dust. The ambient atmosphere feels heavy and airless.
frames.motionDescription: The camera tracks horizontally alongside the figure, maintaining their steady, solitary pace across the wasteland.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - Black Glass Flats - Day
frames.title: The Weight of the Armor
frames.visualDescription: Medium-wide shot of Miguel marching across the Black Glass Flats, full figure visible — his golden celestial plate armor visibly battered and cracked from the Onyx Gates campaign, two enormous pearl-white wings trailing behind him, feathers lightly stained with fine grey ash. The fused black glass ground stretches flat and reflective around him.
frames.motionDescription: Steady lateral tracking shot at knee height, keeping pace with Miguel's stride as the glass terrain slides past.
frames.audioDescription: Each step produces a sharp, brittle crack as the black glass splinters beneath his sabatons; a low, dry wind hisses across the flat expanse.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - Black Glass Flats - Day
frames.title: Splintering Ground
frames.visualDescription: Low, close shot on Miguel's sabatons striking the black glass — the surface fracturing into a spiderweb of cracks with each footfall, fine ash puffing up around his boots.
frames.motionDescription: Static camera with a slight handheld tremor, holding tight on the ground-level impact.
frames.audioDescription: A dry, rhythmic crunch with each step, echoing faintly across the empty flats; a distant heat-distortion hum underneath.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - Black Glass Flats - Day
frames.title: Twelve Days
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's face and shoulders, ash-white hair windswept, a faint cyan glow contained within his eyes, his expression carrying the exhaustion of twelve days of travel. His wings are partially visible behind him, feathers dulled with grey ash and old burn wear.
frames.motionDescription: Slow, almost imperceptible push-in on his face.
frames.audioDescription: Wind fades to near silence; his breathing is audible, slow and effortful.

frames.title: The Failing Armor
frames.visualDescription: Close tracking shot following Miguel from the side as he walks through the Ash Dunes, his ash-white hair stirring faintly in the dry wind, eyes glowing faintly cyan.
frames.motionDescription: Camera tracks alongside at shoulder height, matching his pace precisely.
frames.audioDescription: Fine dust hissing against armor plating; the dry rasp of wind moving sand.

frames.title: Cracks Spiderweb
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's breastplate — deep cracks spiderwebbing visibly across the gold plate, the metal flexing slightly with each labored stride.
frames.motionDescription: Static camera, subtle handheld breathing motion.
frames.audioDescription: A low metallic groan with each step; his breath grows shallow and grit-coated.

frames.title: The Hollow
frames.visualDescription: Close-up as Miguel's gauntleted hand rises instinctively to the center of his sternum, pressing against an unseen wound; his gaze fixed on the distant horizon, haunted by an unnamed question.
frames.motionDescription: Camera holds still, then drifts almost imperceptibly closer to his hand.
frames.audioDescription: Wind drops to near-total silence; a faint, cold resonant hum underscores the moment.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - The Buried Road - Continuous
frames.title: Something Solid
frames.visualDescription: Wide-medium shot of Miguel trudging up the face of a steep ash dune, boots sinking into grey powder — until his stride catches, his foot striking something solid beneath the surface.
frames.motionDescription: Camera tracks low alongside his climbing stride, then holds as he stops abruptly.
frames.audioDescription: The soft crunch of ash underfoot shifts suddenly to a dull, solid thud; the wind quiets as if the moment itself holds its breath.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - The Buried Road - Continuous
frames.title: Worked Stone
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's gauntleted fingers brushing ash away, revealing the perfectly square edge of a worked paving block beneath the soot; a second and third block emerge as he clears more space.
frames.motionDescription: Slow, deliberate push-in on his hands and the stone.
frames.audioDescription: Fine ash sifting away with each brush of his fingers; distant wind, otherwise near-silent.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - The Buried Road - Continuous
frames.title: The Buried Road
frames.visualDescription: Wide reveal shot as a broad, ancient road emerges from the waste — paving stones running in a straight, defiant line toward the same horizon Miguel has been following, most of it still buried beneath the dunes on either side.
frames.motionDescription: Slow pull-back and crane up, revealing the scale and direction of the road against the desolate landscape.
frames.audioDescription: Wind picks up faintly, carrying a low, almost reverent tone; Miguel's breathing steadies.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. Serephis - The Buried Road - Continuous
frames.title: The Trembling Stops
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's face as he looks down at the worked stone, then back toward his own chest, toward the hollow; for the first time in twelve days, his hand stops trembling.
frames.motionDescription: Static, intimate close-up, minimal movement.
frames.audioDescription: Near silence, the wind fully faded; the faint cold resonant hum returns subtly, then settles.

frames.title: The Chord of Harmony
frames.visualDescription: Soft blue-silver light entering from the edge of frame over Miguel seen from behind; GABRIEL appearing, wings folding against the desert gloom.
frames.motionDescription: Static camera, faint drift.
frames.audioDescription: A clean chord of harmony cuts the silence; desert wind underneath.

frames.title: Relief and Shame
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on MIGUEL, an expression caught between physical relief and shame at being seen like this.
frames.motionDescription: Very slow push-in.
frames.audioDescription: Wind fading under Gabriel's glow.

frames.title: The Council Is Concerned
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on GABRIEL, warm, contained worry.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Low harmonic chord, faint wind. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "The Council is concerned, Miguel."

frames.title: The Council's Fear
frames.visualDescription: Same framing as the previous shot, the strain of a plea already audible.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Low harmonic chord, faint wind. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "They fear this is a deception, a lure the enemy crafted to draw you out. Your absence puts fear in the Host."

frames.title: They Think Me a Fool
frames.visualDescription: Reverse-shot, close-up on MIGUEL, voice rough with disuse.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Faint wind bed, no music. Dialogue: MIGUEL says: "They think me a fool. Or a traitor."

frames.title: The Sealed Parchment
frames.visualDescription: Medium shot of GABRIEL; as he shifts his weight, a wax-sealed parchment is briefly visible against his ribs, hidden again an instant later. Cut to close-up on MIGUEL, his jaw loosening for one instant.
frames.motionDescription: Slight lateral shift as Gabriel repositions, then cut to a static close-up on Miguel.
frames.audioDescription: Soft rustle of fabric; the harmony fades almost to silence. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "They think you are their general."

frames.title: The Fortress Falls
frames.visualDescription: Wide shot of the Burning Fortress collapsing — black stone columns cracking and sinking into darkness, fissures of infernal fire, sulfur smoke everywhere.
frames.motionDescription: Unstable handheld camera.
frames.audioDescription: Massive structural groaning, fire roaring.

frames.title: Miguel Down
frames.visualDescription: MIGUEL fallen among the rubble, one wing broken and smoldering beside him.
frames.motionDescription: Handheld, moving closer.
frames.audioDescription: The structure groaning, more muffled.

frames.title: Gabriel Arrives Unbidden
frames.visualDescription: GABRIEL running in through the flames, sent by no one, and kneeling at Miguel's side.
frames.motionDescription: Handheld following his run, settling as he kneels.
frames.audioDescription: Fire crackling, urgent footsteps.

frames.title: Cauterizing the Wing
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on GABRIEL cauterizing Miguel's wing with his own light.
frames.motionDescription: Static, warm light illuminating his focused face.
frames.audioDescription: The crackling fire fades under the soft hum of the healing light. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "Because you don't yell for help in the voice you use for people you love. You go yourself."

frames.title: The Wing Heals
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's wing healing under Gabriel's light, the charred feathers settling.
frames.motionDescription: Slow push-in.
frames.audioDescription: The hum of the healing light, near silence.

frames.title: Return to the Present
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on GABRIEL's hand, now back in Serephis's cold light, rising, hesitating, and falling back to his side without completing the gesture.
frames.motionDescription: Hidden cut symmetrical to the flashback's entry.
frames.audioDescription: The desert wind returns.

frames.title: Come Home
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on GABRIEL, maximum warmth.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Faint wind. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "Come home. Whatever this wound is, we face it together. As we always have."

frames.title: Miguel's Doubt
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on MIGUEL, visible conflict, no dialogue.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Near total silence.

frames.title: I Cannot
frames.visualDescription: MIGUEL looks down at the buried road's stones beneath his feet, then looks up and meets Gabriel's eyes for the first time since he arrived — a terrible, crystalline resolve.
frames.motionDescription: Static, slight push-in on the final line.
frames.audioDescription: Near silence. Dialogue: MIGUEL says: "I cannot. This call is a command more fundamental than any the Council can give me. It is a truth I must find, or I am nothing."

frames.title: Gabriel's Farewell
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on GABRIEL, his light dimming, a single tear of light tracing his cheek, head inclining.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: The harmony fading. Dialogue: GABRIEL says: "May you find what you seek, brother."

frames.title: Miguel Alone
frames.visualDescription: Medium shot, MIGUEL looking at the empty space where Gabriel stood; the desert's heat and silence return, heavier than before.
frames.motionDescription: Static, slight zoom-out.
frames.audioDescription: The wind returns, more present than ever.

frames.title: One Step, Another World
frames.visualDescription: Extreme close-up on Miguel's boot crossing, in a single step, from hot sand/glass to cool green moss — the cut happens on the footstep itself.
frames.motionDescription: Hidden cut on the step's motion.
frames.audioDescription: The desert's dry wind cuts abruptly to a still, metallic silence.

frames.title: The Grove
frames.visualDescription: Wide shot revealing the Grove in full — perfect rows of identical pale pewter-metal trees, thin metal-leaf foliage, dull green moss underfoot, even light with no shadows anywhere; MIGUEL small and alone at the threshold.
frames.motionDescription: Slow lateral reveal as Miguel steps deeper in.
frames.audioDescription: Near total silence; each footstep sounds abnormally loud.

frames.title: Ambush
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on MIGUEL's face, wary, scanning the surroundings with tactical instinct.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Tense silence.

frames.title: A Verse Unremembered
frames.visualDescription: Miguel walks deeper among the metal trees, trying to recite a verse of the Divine Song to center himself, but the words escape him.
frames.motionDescription: Slow tracking shot following him from behind.
frames.audioDescription: The watchful silence, almost no sound at all.

frames.title: A Shout in a Library
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on a single metal leaf cracking under his boot.
frames.motionDescription: Static, very close to the ground.
frames.audioDescription: The crack of the leaf, exaggerated in the silence.

frames.title: Measured
frames.visualDescription: Miguel stops, the sense of being measured by something unseen settling over him.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Total silence, no wind.

frames.title: A Flaw in the Light
frames.visualDescription: One of the metal trees, some forty paces off, no longer matches the angle of the others — MIGUEL turns and finds the PEWTER SENTINEL, tall as the trees, smooth featureless face, two dim eyes glowing from the mist.
frames.motionDescription: Slight zoom-in as the Sentinel is revealed.
frames.audioDescription: Absolute silence, no wind.

frames.title: I Have Come for What Is Mine
frames.visualDescription: Medium shot, MIGUEL facing the PEWTER SENTINEL.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Silence. Dialogue: MIGUEL says: "I have come for what is mine."

frames.title: No Answer
frames.visualDescription: The PEWTER SENTINEL remains motionless, offering no reply; its stillness feels like an answer regardless.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: Absolute silence.

frames.title: Testing the Line
frames.visualDescription: Miguel takes a step toward the grove's center, testing the silence for a line he isn't meant to cross.
frames.motionDescription: Slight tracking shot following him.
frames.audioDescription: Only his own footsteps.

frames.title: The Sentinel Turns
frames.visualDescription: The PEWTER SENTINEL turns smooth and soundless to keep facing MIGUEL as he walks past, like a compass needle.
frames.motionDescription: Slow tracking shot alongside Miguel, the Sentinel pivoting in the background/side of frame.
frames.audioDescription: Silence, only Miguel's footsteps.

frames.title: A Weight on His Back
frames.visualDescription: Shot from behind Miguel as he walks away, the Sentinel's gaze felt as a weight on his back long after the trees hide it from view.
frames.motionDescription: Slow rear tracking shot.
frames.audioDescription: Silence, footsteps growing more distant.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: The Great Ash
frames.visualDescription: Wide shot of the great ash tree at the clearing's center, bark like cooled black lava, roots drinking from a pool of static silver light.
frames.motionDescription: Slow reveal.
frames.audioDescription: The low, cold hum of the clearing.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: Opening Frame of the Push-In
frames.visualDescription: MIGUEL standing at the edge of the clearing, seeing the great ash tree for the first time in the distance; driven into the trunk, SOLMIRE, living white-glacial light.
frames.motionDescription: Wide-to-medium shot, Miguel small against the tree.
frames.audioDescription: The low, cold hum of the clearing, library-like silence.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: Continuous Push-In
frames.visualDescription: The camera has advanced; Solmire now fills more of the frame, its light reflecting in the silver pool.
frames.motionDescription: Continuation of the previous shot's push-in (chain via start/end frames).
frames.audioDescription: The hum grows slightly in intensity.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: Recognition
frames.visualDescription: Close-up on Miguel's face — absolute, terrifying recognition: that is what was taken from me.
frames.motionDescription: Static.
frames.audioDescription: The hum intensifying.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: The Trembling Hand
frames.visualDescription: Extreme close-up on Miguel's gauntleted hand, trembling, inches from the hilt; his face barely visible at the edge of frame, an expression caught between hunger and dread.
frames.motionDescription: End of the chained push-in.
frames.audioDescription: The hum becomes an almost physical vibration, resonating beneath his ribs.

frames.sceneTitle: Ext. The Ash Tree Clearing - Continuous
frames.title: The Forest Vanishes
frames.visualDescription: The instant skin touches hilt, a white-glacial flash consumes the frame entirely.
frames.motionDescription: Hard cut on the flash — the only deliberate visible cut of the whole chapter.
frames.audioDescription: The hum cuts sharply to total silence.
